cases.description: The chain root's drag is edited from (0, 0, 1) to (0, 0, 3): the followers it carries and every downstream turn and drag replay onto the higher pose.
The chain root's drag is re-targeted to the middle link: `object-a` stays, `object-b` moves and its crossing attractions re-derive, and the downstream gestures replay on that.
The drag is edited to a zero offset: the edited gesture reports a Warning-level no-op and the downstream gestures replay as if it never moved anything.
The chain root's quarter turn is edited to an eighth turn; the downstream drag of the middle link replays from the new pose.
The turn is re-targeted to the root AND the locked `object-c`: the edited gesture reports the lock as Warning-level `mutation.partial` and turns the rest.
The root's scaling is edited from 2 to (0.5, 1, 1); scaling moves no pose, so only the scale replays and the downstream drag lands as before.
The scaling is re-targeted from the root to `object-d`.
The edited drag is re-targeted to a ghost: it reports Error-level `mutation.target-missing`, which blocks finalizing, and the downstream drag still replays.

description: Time travel over the puzzle 3d selection leaves: each case edits ONE recorded gesture's inputs; `preview` is the state right before it plus the draft (nothing downstream), `replayed` the fresh fold of the edited log, `outcomes` the per-mutation outcomes of the Report replay from the edited gesture on.
